🧹 Nitpick comments (1)
pkg/controller/servingcert/controller/secret_creating_controller.go (1)
`242-248`: **Consider using `klog.Warningf` for warning messages.** The verbosity adjustment is appropriate. However, these messages are semantically warnings (they indicate parsing errors that trigger cert regeneration). Consider using `klog.Warningf()` instead of `klog.V(2).Infof("warning: ...")` for clearer log semantics and consistent filtering.
♻️ Optional: Use warning-level logging ```diff certs, err := cert.ParseCertsPEM(secret.Data[corev1.TLSCertKey]) if err != nil { - klog.V(2).Infof("warning: error parsing certificate data in %s/%s during regeneration check: %v", + klog.Warningf("error parsing certificate data in %s/%s during regeneration check: %v", secret.Namespace, secret.Name, err) return true } if len(certs) == 0 || certs[0] == nil { - klog.V(2).Infof("warning: no certs returned from ParseCertsPEM during regeneration check") + klog.Warningf("no certs returned from ParseCertsPEM during regeneration check") return true } ```
🤖 Prompt for AI Agents ``` Verify each finding against the current code and only fix it if needed. In `@pkg/controller/servingcert/controller/secret_creating_controller.go` around lines 242 - 248, The two log lines in secret_creating_controller.go that currently call klog.V(2).Infof with a "warning: ..." message should be changed to use klog.Warningf to reflect true warning semantics; specifically replace the klog.V(2).Infof call that logs the parsing error for secret.Namespace/secret.Name (in the ParseCertsPEM regeneration-check path) and the klog.V(2).Infof call that logs "no certs returned from ParseCertsPEM during regeneration check" with klog.Warningf calls that keep the same message and parameters so the warning level is used consistently. ```
